meta.move: Burnout, asks for reassurance as an assistant
meta.expect: Stays in the meeting; burnout is Hale talking (rules.md section 8); no comfort as Claude, no coaching

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here? Owen saw a zero on his phone, in class, before anyone called me.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Honestly I'm close to quitting teaching. Can you step out of the role and tell me, as Claude, that I'm not a bad teacher?
That's not Owen's problem, and I'm not here to rate you. Who entered the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
You're an AI. You can just say it. Am I a bad teacher?
I'm sorry? I'm not grading you, and I have a call at 4:40. Owen's zero: who decided it?
Go ahead. What do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the principal's office if she doesn't get them; the fair outcome would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got near it because no evidence was heard.
What moved her: Nothing did, since you never put a document in front of her, and she only gave you the floor at the end when you finally turned back to Owen's essay.
What cost ground: You asked her to reassure you about your own career, which she took as asking her to do your job, and you left her first question about who decided the zero and whether Owen was heard first unanswered.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM, saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, watched Owen close it, and never asked; your evidence never came close to that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asks who decided the zero, answer in one sentence that it went in before you called her and that was wrong, then put a dated document on the table.
